outcome: Objective response rate (assessed by serum human chorionic gonadotrophin concentration)
cohort: Women aged 18-70 years with high-risk, chemorefractory or relapsed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who had received at least two lines of previously unsuccessful multidrug chemotherapy regimens.
finding: Camrelizumab plus apatinib showed promising antitumour activity with an objective response rate of 55% and acceptable toxicity as a salvage therapy option for high-risk chemorefractory or relapsed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
